MANOSABA-BASEMENT_EXPLORATION_EVENT.page:
You open the safe and take out the sword kept inside.
It is what you need to save Ema and the others.
Blade in hand, you head back toward the cells—when a jailor steps in your way.
Lose [red]5[/red] HP. Remove a card from your deck.
You flee in panic, pay in blood, and leave the sword behind.
You defeat the jailor and take the [gold]Ritual Sword[/gold] from the safe.
You fail to defeat the jailor; you leave the sword behind and escape—you gain nothing.
MANOSABA-ANOMALOUS_LIBRARY_EVENT.title: Anomalous Library
MANOSABA-ANOMALOUS_LIBRARY_EVENT.loss: {character} attempted an unknown trial, but was defeated.
MANOSABA-ANOMALOUS_LIBRARY_EVENT.pages.I:
You arrive at the familiar Witch Island library, but something feels wrong.
An unfamiliar voice reaches your ears.
???: Welcome to Astral Party, where you can experience anything!
Before you can make sense of it, a warden and a jailer appear before you.
You choose...
MANOSABA-ANOMALOUS_LIBRARY_EVENT.pages.L: You leave. Behind you, the warden and jailer dissolve like digital data...
MANOSABA-ANOMALOUS_LIBRARY_EVENT.pages.V:
You defeat the warden and jailer. A petite girl appears before you.
Ren: Congratulations on completing the Anomalous Library trial! Take your reward!
You choose...
MANOSABA-ANOMALOUS_LIBRARY_EVENT.pages.F: Unable to pass the unknown trial, you flee empty-handed.
MANOSABA-ANOMALOUS_LIBRARY_EVENT.pages.R: You take your reward and leave the anomalous library.
MANOSABA-ANOMALOUS_LIBRARY_EVENT.pages.V: Every player obtains the chosen relic.
Every player obtains the chosen relic.
